senses.gloss: सञ्चक सञ्चक (m.?), Stamp, and disc (of the moon), Naiṣ. 22, 47; 48 (Sch. ad 47).

1. सञ्ज् सञ्ज्, i. 1, सज, Par. The pass. सज्य has become very often सज्ज, which in epic poetry appears with the terminations of the Par. (MBh. 1, 7694), whence सज्ज् has begun to be considered as a radical vb., To adhere, Ragh. 4, 47; Chr. 20, 20; नहि वाणा मयोत्सृष्टाः सज्जन्तीह शरीरिणां कायेषु, literally, ‘For the arrows cast by me do not stick to the bodies of living men,’ i. e. ‘all those who are hit by my arrows will die.’ Pass.
 1. To be attached, MBh. 3, 63.
 2. To become attached, Man. 6, 55.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. सक्त.
 1. Attached, Man. 7, 30.
 2. Devoted.
 3. Diligent, intent on.
 4. Impending, Pañc. 186, 24.
 5. Belonging, Pañc. 222, 13; related, 89, 18.
 6. Concerning, Pañc. 221, 14.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. To pimp, Man. 8, 362 (सज्जय).
 --With the prep. अति अति, षञ्ज्; अति-सक्त (i. e. सक्त with अति), Exceedingly attached, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 21.
 --With व्यति वि-अति,
 1. Par. To connect mutually, Utt. Rāmac. 146, 8.
 2. Ātm. To change, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 3. व्यतिषक्त, Intermarrying, Man. 10, 25.
 --With अनु अनु, षञ्ज्, To cling, to cleave, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 15. Pass. To be attached to, Bhag. 6, 4. []
 --With अभि अभि, षञ्ज्, To humiliate, MBh. 3, 1090.
 --With अव अव, To suspend, Rām. 3, 53, 52. अवसक्त.
 1. Hanging, MBh. 1, 1692.
 2. Taken hold of, and pervaded, Śiś. 9, 7.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To fix, to put on, MBh. 3, 16125.
 2. To entrust, MBh. 1, 1955. Pass. To be attached or fettered, Śāk. d. 74. आसक्त,
 1. Attached, Rām. 3, 50, 9.
 2. Intent on, occupied, Pañc. 27, 9; zealously following.
 3. Trusting to.
 4. Eternal.
 5. ˚तम्, adv. Eternally.
 --Caus. सञ्जय, To cause to be attached, Ragh. 6, 83.
 --With व्या वि-आ, व्यासक्त, Occupied, Vikr. 60, 6.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To attach, MBh. 1, 4418.
 2. To entrust, to resign to, Man. 4, 257. समासक्त,
 1. Attached, Rām. 2, 64, 9.
 2. Joined.
 3. Combined.
 4. Marked, affected by.
 --With उद् उद्, To attach, Mālat. 172, 13. उत्सक्त, Attached, Rājat. 5, 127.
 --With नि नि, निषक्त, Fixed, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 3.
 --With प्र प्र, To attach one's self, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 3. Pass.
 1. To be strongly addicted, Man. 4, 16.
 2. To be relevant, to apply, Bhāṣāp. 61. प्रसक्त,
 1. Attached to, Pañc. ii. d. 3.
 2. Fettered, Pañc. i. d. 208.
 3. Engaged in, Pañc. 197, 25.
 4. Connected with.
 5. Obtained.
 6. Employed.
 7. Continual, Mālat. 70, 19; eternal.
 8. Opened, expanded, Utt. Rāmac. 118, 5.
 9. ˚तम्, adv. Continually.
 --With अतिप्र अति-प्र in अतिप्रसक्त, i. e. प्रसक्त with अति, Too much attached, Pañc. i. d. 201.
 --With अनुप्र अनु-प्र, अनुप्रसक्त, Attached, Śiś. 9, 63.
 --With वि वि, विषक्त,
 1. Hung up, Śāk. d. 31.
 2. Adhering closely, firmly rooted, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 23; Utt. Rāmac. 94, 12.
 3. In contact with.
 --With [] सम् सम्, pass.
 1. To adhere, MBh. 3, 17228.
 2. To be entwined, MBh. 2, 917.
 3. To be connected, Rām. 2, 25, 37. संसक्त,
 1. Attached to, Pañc. i. d. 192; attached, Mālat. 145, 11.
 2. Tied, connected, Rājat. 5, 366.
 3. Restrained, Nal. 13, 21.
 4. Endowed with.
 5. Joined, linked together.
 6. Contiguous.
 --Cf. σάττω (for σαγyω), σαγή, σάγμα, σακτός, σάκτωρ, probably σάκκος, σάκτας.
सञ्जतर सञ्जतर, n. The name of a city, Pañc. 118, 22.
